item.title: Leaves clogging the pavement and causing a trip hazard, 10th November
item.description:
I’ve reported this problem before using my address and 2 men came out today and picked up the leaves only in front of my house. The entire section of street needs collection (on both sides of the pavement) as the pavements are impassable especially for pushchairs and wheelchairs. I had to walk in the road with a pushchair last week as the pavements are so clogged and the leaves get stuck in the pushchair. Please sort this problem properly and on a regular basis throughout the autumn until all leaves have fallen from these enormous and uncared for trees.
